shortDescription: Fetch configuration/state data from gRPC enabled target hosts.

options.name: command
options.description: The option specifies the command to be executed on the target host and return the response in result. This option is supported if the gRPC target host supports executing CLI command over the gRPC connection.

options.name: data_type
options.description: The type of data that should be fetched from the target host. The value depends on the capability of the gRPC server running on target host. The values can be I(config), I(oper) etc. based on what is supported by the gRPC server. By default it will return both configuration and operational state data in response.

options.name: display
options.description: Encoding scheme to use when serializing output from the device. The encoding scheme value depends on the capability of the gRPC server running on the target host. The values can be I(json), I(text) etc.

options.name: section
options.description: This option specifies the string which acts as a filter to restrict the portions of the data to be retrieved from the target host device. If this option is not specified the entire configuration or state data is returned in response provided it is supported by target host.
